subject: A-Level History
breadthStudy: A long-running thematic study spanning 100+ years (e.g., British political history 1785–1870, or Cold War 1941–1991)
depthStudy: An in-depth period study of approximately 25–50 years with detailed event and causation analysis
historicalInvestigation: Coursework: independent research essay (3000–3500 words) evaluating primary and secondary sources
examFormat: Paper 1: Breadth (2hr 30min) | Paper 2: Depth (1hr 30min) | Coursework: 3000–3500 word investigation (AQA)
